disciplines.name: Mining
disciplines.description: Mining: judge local conditions, practise safe methods and pass reliable results to the next household.

gates.description: Practise mining for 30 days.
Complete a seasonal cycle with at least 91 days of careful mining (care ≥70%).
Three years of mining; key attribute ≥12.
Complete a mining task yielding at least 120% of its base.
Learn mining from a level-30 teacher, or gain an insight.
Ten years of mining, an insight and key attribute ≥14.

An insight, a life-defining work and cultivation realm 2 (future).
